text: In the one day since the last run (10 November), electronics (about +1,000 reviews) and beauty (about +830) again moved most on Amazon, led by a OnePlus neckband (+75), Apple EarPods (+70) and Ghar Soaps bath bars (+104), while Diwali string lights were still collecting reviews, likely from buyers reviewing after the festival. For a beginner, sling and crossbody bags, simple toys and small fitness items look most reachable, because big brands lead almost everything else.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurta sets lead, Banarasi and Kanjivaram-style sarees rise
text: Kurta sets from GoSriKi and Klosia have the most reviews, and a ₹799 Klosia Anarkali set gained the most in a day (+28), with a ₹652 GoSriKi set (+15) and a ₹748 Parthvi set (+11) next; the category added about 190 reviews. Eight listings are new, mostly Banarasi, Kanjivaram-style, chiffon and georgette sarees from C J Enterprise, Yashika and others around ₹500 to ₹550, which likely fits the wedding season. The typical price is about ₹652, and the top 10 products have about 11.3% 1-star reviews, the highest on Amazon. Sizes and complaints make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Women's western: Amazon's Symbol leads, maxi dresses and Korean-style tops rise
text: Amazon's own Symbol T-shirts have the most reviews, followed by Fabricorn T-shirts and Leriya Fashion dresses. Growth was small, about 80 reviews in a day, with a ₹599 Shasmi maxi dress marketed for New Year parties (+13) and a ₹425 bandhani maxi dress (+8) gaining most. Embroidered Korean-style tops from Rieka around ₹645 to ₹695 are rising, and oversized T-shirts, crop shirts and a zipper T-shirt are new to the list. The typical price is about ₹508, and the top 10 have about 9.4% 1-star reviews, so sizes and fit are a real risk.

headline: Men's clothing: Allen Solly and Van Heusen lead, jackets and checked shirts rise
text: Allen Solly, Van Heusen and Amazon's Symbol lead with polo T-shirts, and an Allen Solly sweatshirt leads winter wear. A ₹748 Lymio hooded jacket gained the most in a day (+18), just ahead of the Allen Solly polo (+17), and checked and linen casual shirts from Deemoon and Deelmo around ₹495 are rising. The category added about 260 reviews, the typical price is about ₹579, and the top 10 have about 9.1% 1-star reviews. Strong brands plus sizes make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: Uno and soft toys lead, tricycles and scooters move
text: A ₹97 Uno card game has the most reviews, followed by an ₹89 Babique rattle soft toy and the ₹156 Uno No Mercy game. Growth was small, about 190 reviews in a day, led by Uno No Mercy (+19), an ₹899 Lifelong kick scooter (+18) and a ₹1,099 Lifelong tricycle (+17), likely early gift buying for Children's Day on 14 November and Christmas. Girls' winter, hoodie and ethnic co-ord sets are new on the clothing list but have few reviews so far. The top 10 have about 8.4% 1-star reviews; Mattel leads card games, but simple unbranded toys are reachable for a beginner.

headline: Home & kitchen: Pigeon and Milton lead, small kitchen tools keep moving
text: A ₹189 Pigeon mini chopper has the most reviews by far, followed by Milton steel bottles and Ajanta clocks. In a day, a ₹259 Aliston kitchen scale (+33), One94Store, DesiDiya and Gesto LED string lights (+26 to +31) and a ₹69 gas lighter (+24) gained most; the lights are likely being reviewed after Diwali and their demand should now fade. New to the list are more Milton bottles, Milton fridge storage boxes, a Sumeet masala box and a Lifelong gas stove, and a ₹188 glass oil sprayer is rising. The typical price is about ₹299, and the top 10 have about 7.9% 1-star reviews; small kitchen tools are a good beginner route, but avoid competing head-on with Pigeon and Milton.

headline: Beauty: Dettol, Vaseline and Nivea lead, winter body lotions keep arriving
text: Big brands lead: Dettol handwash refills, Vaseline, Cetaphil, Parachute and Nivea. In a day, Ghar Soaps bath bars (+104), Cetaphil face wash (+59) and Simple, Minimalist and Bare Anatomy products (+35 to +38) gained most, and new Vaseline, Parachute and Nivea body lotions likely reflect winter dry skin. The category added about 830 reviews, second on Amazon, the typical price is about ₹284, and the top 10 have about 5.7% 1-star reviews. Demand is strong but brand-led, so a beginner would need brand approval or their own brand.

headline: Jewellery: small, slow list, YouBella and Shining Diva lead
text: Only 30 products were read, and the Women's Jewellery list again added almost nothing, so treat this category with care: the whole category gained only about 33 reviews in a day. YouBella bracelets, earrings and American diamond sets and Shining Diva sets and bracelets lead at about ₹165 to ₹350, and a Shining Diva five-piece pearl necklace combo (+5) gained most. New items include Kashmiri glass bangles, a men's gold plated chain and a zircon bracelet, and Rajasthani lac bangles are rising, which likely fits the wedding season. The top 10 have about 9.3% 1-star reviews; jewellery is light and has no sizes, but Amazon buyers review it much less than Meesho buyers.

headline: Bags & footwear: orthopedic slippers lead, crossbody bags rise
text: Doctor Extra Soft orthopedic slippers have the most reviews, and Lavie handbags lead bags at about ₹1,199 to ₹1,299. The category added only about 110 reviews in a day, led by Doctor Extra Soft and Ortho Joy slippers (+8 each) and ₹599 Asian sneakers (+6). Walizza and Lyrovo crossbody and sling bags around ₹480 to ₹570 are rising, with a Walizza sling bag now at #1 among newcomers, and more orthopedic slippers from Frido and Doctor Health are new. The typical price is about ₹595 and the top 10 have about 7.9% 1-star reviews; bags have no sizes, so they suit a beginner better than shoes.

headline: Electronics: OnePlus, JBL and boAt lead, chargers and phone cases rise
text: OnePlus, JBL, boAt and realme earphones have the most reviews by far. Electronics gained the most reviews of any Amazon category (about +1,000 in a day), led by a OnePlus neckband (+75), Apple EarPods (+70), OnePlus Nord earbuds (+66) and a ₹298 Portronics wired earphone (+44). Samsung chargers and cables, Portronics and Ambrane cables, an Ambrane power bank and phone cases for the Galaxy A17 and iPhone 15 are new or rising. The typical price is about ₹639 and the top 10 have about 9.4% 1-star reviews; brands dominate, so only simple phone cases suit a beginner.

headline: Health & fitness: Dettol, Havells and Philips lead, pull-up bars and hand grippers rise
text: Personal care is led by Dettol, Havells, Philips and Nivea, and a Philips men's trimmer gained the most in a day (+42), with a ₹164 Boldfit hand gripper (+31) and a ₹248 WishCare tinted lip balm (+24) next. The category shows about 4,600 fewer reviews than yesterday, likely because the Exercise & Fitness list changed and now includes sweatshirts and thermal sets, not because buyers removed reviews. Slovic and Lifelong pull-up bars around ₹550 are rising, likely home-gym buying for winter. The typical price is about ₹434 and the top 10 have about 5.8% 1-star reviews, among the lowest on Amazon; trimmers and dryers are brand-led, so a beginner should look at simple fitness accessories.

Crossbody and sling bags around ₹480 to ₹570
Simple toys such as card games and soft toys around ₹90 to ₹160, and kick scooters for gifting
Pull-up bars and hand grippers around ₹160 to ₹550
Small kitchen tools such as oil sprayers, masala boxes and fridge storage boxes
Phone cases for new phone models around ₹300
Traditional jewellery such as lac and glass bangles around ₹190 to ₹300

Avoid for now: earbuds, chargers and trimmers (OnePlus, JBL, boAt, Samsung, Philips and Havells lead), branded skincare and lotions, men's branded T-shirts, and Diwali lights and diyas whose demand likely ends now that the festival is over.
